description: Per-object SEO overrides. Used as a card sub-schema on objects that opt in.
formgrid:
jsonldType jsonldType noindex nofollow
title title socialTitle socialTitle
description description description description
image image image image

id.label: ID
id.help: Reserved — required by the schema system but unused for cards.

title.label: Title
title.help: The page title, used as is. Leave empty to use the site title template.

socialTitle.label: Social Title
socialTitle.help: Short title for share cards (og:title / twitter:title). Leave empty to use the page title.

description.label: Description
description.help: Overrides the meta description for this object

noindex.label: No Index
noindex.help: Ask search engines not to index this page; also removes it from sitemaps

nofollow.label: No Follow
nofollow.help: Ask search engines not to follow links from this page

jsonldType.label: Structured Data Type
jsonldType.help: What this record is, for og:type and the JSON-LD. Automatic is the collection's Structured Data Type for an object, and Webpage for a Site Builder page (a page has no collection setting). Article and Blog post add an Article node and emit article:published_time.
